flow_name: Manage - Users (company users list, search, user details)

_provenance.note: Captured in RC signed in as an Organization Administrator; every target resolved to one visible element. Read-only: ADD USER was not opened.

prerequisite_flows._why: This flow starts signed in. The compiler runs these sign-in steps first when a case does not sign in itself; the Test Data names match the Journey KB role profile (TESTDATA_DEFAULT_ORG_EMAIL, TESTDATA_OTP).

automation_boundary.automated_scope: Authenticated B2B Portal -> Manage -> Users tab -> users table (Full Name, ROLE, Contact, status, Manage), Search Users, row menu -> View user details -> Back.
automation_boundary.external_boundary: User records come from the B2B backend; assert what the portal renders.

canonical_steps.action: Sign in to the B2B Portal as an Organization Administrator
canonical_steps.expected_result: The authenticated B2B Portal home page is displayed

canonical_steps.action: Open the Manage section from the main navigation
canonical_steps.expected_result: The Manage page opens on the Organization Details tab

canonical_steps.action: Verify the users table column headers
canonical_steps.expected_result: Columns Full Name, ROLE, Contact, status and Manage are displayed
Each user shows PENDING, ACTIVE or INACTIVE

canonical_steps.action: Type a user's name in the 'Search Users' box
Open the row menu of the first user

canonical_steps.expected_result: The user detail page shows the user's name, status, role, Email and Phone

canonical_steps.action: Click 'Back' on the user detail page
canonical_steps.expected_result: The Users list is shown again

known_records._note: RC, organisation Travel Agency 505272625, 2026-10-21. Rows change as users are added.

_canonical_steps_note: Verify steps carry no target on purpose: the step matcher lends a verify canonical step's selector to any verify step of a matched case. Assertions come from the label the case quotes; the verified field XPaths are in app_profile.json selectors.trade_license_modal / manage_users.
